description: This Java source file defines the BorderedText class, which provides functionality for rendering text with borders onto a Canvas in Android applications. It encapsulates properties such as colors, text size, typeface, and rendering methods for drawing bordered and multiple lines of text.

classes.name: BorderedText
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the tedious bits of rendering legible, bordered text onto a canvas. Supports setting colors, typeface, text size, and drawing bordered text and multiple lines.

methods.name: BorderedText
methods.description: Constructor to create a BorderedText with specified interior and exterior colors and text size.

methods.name: setTypeface
methods.description: Sets the typeface for both interior and exterior paints.

methods.name: drawText
methods.description: Draws bordered text at specified x,y position on the Canvas.

methods.name: drawLines
methods.description: Draws multiple lines of text vertically aligned starting from a position.

methods.name: getTextSize
methods.description: Returns the text size used for drawing.

methods.name: setAlpha
methods.description: Sets the transparency level for both paints.

methods.name: getTextBounds
methods.description: Calculates the bounding rectangle of a given text line.

methods.name: setTextAlign
methods.description: Sets the alignment of the text for both paints.
